name: Future Or Option Details 3
definition: Parameters for contracts which obligate the buyer to receive and the seller to deliver in the future the assets specified at an agreed price or contracts which grant to the holder either the privilege to purchase or the privilege to sell the assets specified at a predetermined price or formula at or within a time in the future.

FutureAndOptionContractType.name: Future And Option Contract Type
FutureAndOptionContractType.definition: Specifies the type of the contract for futures and options.

LastDeliveryDate.name: Last Delivery Date
LastDeliveryDate.definition: Last date/time by which the option for physical delivery may still be exercised.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Used to indicate the size of the underlying commodity on which the contract is based (e.g., 2500 lbs of lean cattle, 1000 barrels of crude oil, 1000 bushels of corn, etc.).

FutureDate.name: Future Date
FutureDate.definition: Date on which future contracts settle.

MinimumSize.name: Minimum Size
MinimumSize.definition: Specifies the minimum ratio or multiply factor used to convert from contracts to shares.

AnnouncementDate.name: Announcement Date
AnnouncementDate.definition: Date/time, as announced by the issuer, at which the securities will be issued.

Appearance.name: Appearance
Appearance.definition: Specifies the deliverability of a security.

StrippableIndicator.name: Strippable Indicator
StrippableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest is separable from the principal.

PositionLimit.name: Position Limit
PositionLimit.definition: Indicates the maximum number of listed option contracts on a single security which can be held by an investor or group of investors acting jointly.

NearTermPositionLimit.name: Near Term Position Limit
NearTermPositionLimit.definition: Position limit in the near-term contract for a given exchange-traded product.

MinimumTradingPricingIncrement.name: Minimum Trading Pricing Increment
MinimumTradingPricingIncrement.definition: Minimum price increase for a given exchange-traded Instrument.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Reason for which money is raised through the issuance of a security.

ContractSettlementMonth.name: Contract Settlement Month
ContractSettlementMonth.definition: Specifies when the contract (i.e. MBS/TBA) will settle.

FirstDealingDate.name: First Dealing Date
FirstDealingDate.definition: Date on which new securities begin trading.

Ratio.name: Ratio
Ratio.definition: Ratio applied to convert the related security.

IssuePrice.name: Issue Price
IssuePrice.definition: Initial issue price of a financial instrument.

OptionRights.name: Option Rights
OptionRights.definition: Rights to exercise the privilege to purchase or to sell the assets specified at a predetermined price or formula at or within a time in the future.

LastTransaction.name: Last Transaction
LastTransaction.definition: Indicates whether or not this is the last transaction.

SpreadTransaction.name: Spread Transaction
SpreadTransaction.definition: Specifies that there will be one price and one transaction when two contracts are carried out simultaneously, one to buy and the other one to sell with two different expiration dates.
